Apply for the HAX Venture Fellowship - HAX – Hands-on Venture Capital for Hard Tech Skip to content Program Plasma Forge Case Studies Companies Team News Invest Apply Apply Back to news articles Apply for the HAX Venture Fellowship HAX Team July 27, 2022 Announcing the HAX Venture Fellowship, a 1-year program for the next generation of hard tech founders and investors. ‍The HAX Venture Fellowship is a hands-on program for the next generation of Hard Tech founders and investors. The Fellowship The 1-year, part-time program gives Fellows the opportunity to work alongside HAX leadership to bring deep technology from the workshop into the real world. Fellows receive direct exposure to the world of early stage venture investing, and are given responsibilities as a technology scout, investment analyst, and early stage employee at a hard tech startup. The program is best suited for deeply technical individuals – most of whom are currently enrolled in an MBA or PhD program – who are ready to make an impact outside of the lab or workshop. Each cohort of HAX Venture Fellows will bring together individuals from diverse genders, races, orientations, abilities and circumstances. What’s Needed to Apply Please send a resume to hax-interns@sosv.com with the subject line “HAX Venture Fellowship Application”. Please include in the body of the email more information about why you are interested
